thread:
Ivy Nguyen: hey team! first day here in APAC. trying to run a quick model eval in asia-southeast1 but getting permission denied when listing GCE instances. who handles region/billing access? :wave:

Ivy Nguyen: gcloud output:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.list) PERMISSION_DENIED: User does not have permission to list instances on project redwood-apac-sandbox
```

rachel_it: welcome Ivy! :tada: Did you get added to the SSO groups during onboarding? APAC projects require infra-apac at minimum.

Ivy Nguyen: i think i only have the basic "engineering" group currently. filled the onboarding form yesterday.

tom_cloudops: hi Ivy — for GCP you'll need `roles/browser` + `roles/compute.viewer` on the project. For billing, APAC has a separate billing account redwood-apac-billing; you need `billing.viewer` or membership in the billing-viewers group.

Ivy Nguyen: also on AWS my console shows "You are not authorized to perform this operation" when opening Cost Explorer. :confused:

rachel_it: that's expected if the SSO mapping for AWS org roles isn't applied. i'll open a ticket to add you to infra-apac and to request AWS billing-viewer mapping.

infra-bot: Ticket ONB-330 created by rachel_it for user Ivy Nguyen — "APAC infra + billing access". Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-330

tom_cloudops: while IT does the group add i can grant you a 1-hour `roles/compute.viewer` on redwood-apac-sandbox so you can proceed with the eval. i'll log the change.

tom_cloudops: granted `compute.viewer` on project redwood-apac-sandbox to ivy.nguyen@redwood.com (expires in 1h).

Ivy Nguyen: thanks — listing works now and i can ssh into the test vm. :relieved:

Ivy Nguyen: any quick commands i can run to verify the SSO group added later?

rachel_it: once propagation happens run:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-apac-sandbox --filter=bindings.members:ivy.nguyen@redwood.com --format=json
``` 
If you see bindings with infra-apac or billing-viewers you're good. allow 10-20m for SSO sync.

Ivy Nguyen: noted, will check. also can someone link the project to the billing account? the quickstart said projects are auto-linked but this one wasn't.

tom_cloudops: i've requested billing link for redwood-apac-sandbox to redwood-apac-billing. you'll get billing access after the IAM update and link complete.

Ivy Nguyen: aws billing console still blocked but fine for now. thanks for the quick help everyone. excited to dig in! :sparkles:

rachel_it: welcome aboard! i'll update the onboarding doc to call out APAC billing link steps and SSO propagation timings.

Ivy Nguyen: adding to my checklist. appreciate it! :raised_hands:
